import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the GSL libraries in the correct order
libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
libgsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define ctypes structures for GSL types
class gsl_matrix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("size1", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("size2", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("tda", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("owner", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

class gsl_permutation(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)),
        ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("owner", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

# Define the function signature for gsl_linalg_pcholesky_decomp
libgsl.gsl_linalg_pcholesky_decomp.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]
libgsl.gsl_linalg_pcholesky_decomp.restype = ctypes.c_int

libgsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
libgsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix)

libgsl.gsl_permutation_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
libgsl.gsl_permutation_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)

libgsl.gsl_matrix_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
libgsl.gsl_matrix_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
libgsl.gsl_matrix_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

libgsl.gsl_permutation_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation), ctypes.c_size_t]
libgsl.gsl_permutation_get.restype = ctypes.c_size_t

libgsl.gsl_matrix_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix)]
libgsl.gsl_permutation_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]

def gsl_matrix_alloc(rows, cols):
    matrix = libgsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(rows, cols)
    if not matrix:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate gsl_matrix.")
    return matrix

def gsl_permutation_alloc(size):
    perm = libgsl.gsl_permutation_alloc(size)
    if not perm:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate gsl_permutation.")
    return perm

def gsl_matrix_set(matrix, i, j, value):
    libgsl.gsl_matrix_set(matrix, i, j, ctypes.c_double(value))

def gsl_matrix_get(matrix, i, j):
    return libgsl.gsl_matrix_get(matrix, i, j)

def gsl_permutation_get(perm, i):
    return libgsl.gsl_permutation_get(perm, i)

def cholesky_decomposition(input_matrix):
    n = len(input_matrix)

    # Allocate GSL matrix and permutation
    gsl_A = gsl_matrix_alloc(n, n)
    gsl_p = gsl_permutation_alloc(n)

    # Initialize GSL matrix with input data
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            gsl_matrix_set(gsl_A, i, j, input_matrix[i][j])

    # Perform LDLT decomposition
    status = libgsl.gsl_linalg_pcholesky_decomp(gsl_A, gsl_p)
    if status != 0:
        raise ValueError(f"GSL Cholesky decomposition failed with status {status}")

    # Extract results
    result_matrix = [[gsl_matrix_get(gsl_A, i, j) for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    permutation = [gsl_permutation_get(gsl_p, i) for i in range(n)]

    # Free GSL resources
    libgsl.gsl_matrix_free(gsl_A)
    libgsl.gsl_permutation_free(gsl_p)

    return result_matrix, permutation

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: 2x2 symmetric positive-definite matrix
    input_matrix = [
        [2.0, -1.0],
        [-1.0, 2.0]
    ]

    expected_matrix = [
        [2.0, -1.0],
        [-0.5, 1.5]
    ]

    expected_permutation = [0, 1]

    result_matrix, permutation = cholesky_decomposition(input_matrix)

    # Validate results
    np.testing.assert_almost_equal(result_matrix, expected_matrix, decimal=6)
    assert permutation == expected_permutation

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
